# imd/acc: contract integration on Sepolia test run 2

Source: this repository's README.md (Integrating a project),
docs/listing.md, src/Stacker.sol and src/ProjectRegistry.sol.
Chain: Sepolia, 11155111. Start both event scans at block 11891109.

Addresses:
Stacker: 0x0457276d7b036818b3eddc1a4a3fceda61e9314d
ProjectRegistry: 0x3a3bfcb65614292b0ec7c62f9e3a5dac003b920e
TestIMD (staking asset): 0x2b69099e59b05901faa1dd164fabf098bf831e82
TestSIMD (ERC-4626 vault): 0xf9e2eec3b610ec6781f7438ac5fb4bc049d81cc1
Oracle fee token: 0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a
Intake v2: 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82

What happens:
A trade pays cashback out of the project's existing fee. The trading
contract calls Stacker.credit(trader, imdAmount). The Stacker pulls
TestIMD from that caller, deposits into TestSIMD for the trader, and
emits Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares). It has no owner or admin.
A failed credit reverts its transfers. The integrator pays plain IMD
in its catch branch. A zero amount emits no Stacked event.

MUST rules:
- Call credit from the trading contract itself. That contract holds
  the IMD and has approved the Stacker to pull it. msg.sender becomes
  the project in Stacked; a separate funding or forwarding wallet
  would be recorded as the project instead.
- Call credit only inside a real trade, for that trade's real trader.
  Use router hookData, falling back to sender. Never use tx.origin.
  Do not expose an arbitrary-wallet cashback function.
- Fund cashback from the existing fee on the IMD side of the trade.
  Keep the rate in 25-100 bps (0.25%-1%). If fees or rates can change,
  enforce the range and fee guard in code.
- The fee portion that permanently leaves the owner/team must be at
  least the cashback. Burns, forever-locked liquidity, prizes to
  others and third-party fees count. Owner shares, treasury and
  withdrawable owner liquidity do not count.
- Check sufficient gas BEFORE the try/catch. Short gas must revert
  the swap, so gas estimation cannot select a cheaper fallback path.
  Benchmark the complete trade and set an integration-specific gas
  budget. Wallets send the gas estimate multiplied by 1.3.
- Catch a failed credit and safely pay plain IMD to the same trader.
  Test the paused vault failure path on Sepolia.
- For Uniswap v4 hooks, include the afterSwap logic expected by the
  frontend whitelist, support the router's msgSender and warn users
  about copycat v2/v3 pools.
- Skip the call when computed cashback is zero.

Relevant Solidity interfaces:

interface IStacker {
    function IMD() external view returns (address);
    function SIMD() external view returns (address);
    function credit(address trader, uint256 imdAmount)
        external returns (uint256 shares);
    function totalStacked() external view returns (uint256);
    function projectStacked(address project)
        external view returns (uint256);
    function projectShares(address project)
        external view returns (uint256);
    event Stacked(
        address indexed project, address indexed trader,
        uint256 imd, uint256 shares
    );
}

interface IProjectRegistry {
    enum Ask { None, Apply, Challenge }
    struct Project {
        Ask ask;
        bool listed;
        uint16 rateBps;
        uint64 askedAt;
        uint64 fromBlock;
        uint64 toBlock;
        address beneficiary;
        uint64 challengeOpenAt;
        address asker;
        bytes32 intakeId;
    }
    function projectOf(address project)
        external view returns (Project memory);
    function isListed(address project) external view returns (bool);
    function ORACLE_FEE() external view returns (uint256);
    function challengeBond() external view returns (uint256);
    function challengeCooldown() external view returns (uint64);
    function PENDING_EXPIRY() external view returns (uint64);
    function applyQuestion(
        address project, string calldata name,
        string calldata sourceUrl, uint16 rateBps,
        address beneficiary
    ) external view returns (string memory);
    function applyListing(
        address project, string calldata name,
        string calldata sourceUrl, uint16 rateBps,
        address beneficiary
    ) external returns (bytes32 intakeId);
    function challengeForBeneficiary(
        address project, string calldata reason,
        address expectedBeneficiary
    ) external returns (bytes32 intakeId);
    function expire(address project) external;
    event Listed(
        address indexed project, uint16 rateBps,
        address beneficiary, uint64 fromBlock,
        bytes32 oracleRequestId
    );
    event Delisted(
        address indexed project, uint64 toBlock,
        bytes32 oracleRequestId
    );
}

Minimal Solidity integration fragment (Solidity 0.8.26):
Use IStacker above with these imports. Extend the actual trading
contract with this internal helper; it is not a standalone trading
venue. Authenticate the router and obtain the real trader in the
trade callback, then call _cashback there. The supplied minCreditGas_
comes from tests of that integration, including its first credit.
The trading contract must have the cashback IMD from its trade fee.

import {IERC20} from
    "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import {SafeERC20} from
    "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";

abstract contract TradingCashback {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;
    IERC20 public immutable imd;
    IStacker public immutable stacker;
    uint16 public immutable rateBps;
    uint256 public immutable minCreditGas;

    constructor(
        IERC20 imd_, IStacker stacker_, uint16 rateBps_,
        uint256 minCreditGas_
    ) {
        require(rateBps_ >= 25 && rateBps_ <= 100, "rate");
        require(minCreditGas_ > 0, "benchmark gas first");
        imd = imd_;
        stacker = stacker_;
        rateBps = rateBps_;
        minCreditGas = minCreditGas_;
        imd_.forceApprove(address(stacker_), type(uint256).max);
    }

    // Called ONLY from the authenticated trade execution path.
    function _cashback(address trader, uint256 imdSideAmount)
        internal
    {
        uint256 cashback = imdSideAmount * rateBps / 10_000;
        if (cashback == 0) return;
        require(gasleft() >= minCreditGas, "short cashback gas");
        try stacker.credit(trader, cashback) returns (uint256) {
            // Vault shares were minted directly to the trader.
        } catch {
            imd.safeTransfer(trader, cashback);
        }
    }
}

Tests to write for the actual integration:
- Normal trade: Stacked.project is the trading contract itself;
  Stacked.trader is the authenticated trader; IMD and share balances
  match cashback at the current rate. Exercise buys and sells.
- Paused vault: the trade completes and the real trader receives
  plain IMD; no successful Stacked event or vault deposit occurs.
- Short gas: the swap reverts before credit, with no partial trade
  or silently selected plain-IMD path. Test first and repeat credits.
- Zero cashback: skip credit entirely, including at tiny trade sizes.
- No external entry point can pay chosen wallets outside a trade.
- Funding and allowance belong to the trading contract. Verify the
  fee guard, rate bounds and authentic router/trader resolution.

Listing and points:
Anyone can apply. Read ORACLE_FEE() live; zero means unavailable.
Approve exactly the fee in the oracle fee token. A project must
have code. Name: 1-48 characters. HTTPS source URL: 12-200 characters.
Text must be printable ASCII without double quotes, backslashes or
square brackets. Rate: 25-100 bps. Beneficiary must be nonzero. The
project must not already be listed or have an open question.

The IdentityMD oracle panel checks verified source and on-chain
state. True lists the project starting at that block. False rejects
it. A refused or unanswered question clears without a listing.
The beneficiary must belong to the project's owner, team or treasury.

After challengeOpenAt, anyone can challenge a listed project with
no open question. Approve exactly ORACLE_FEE() + challengeBond().
Use challengeForBeneficiary with the reviewed beneficiary. If it
still meets the rules, the bond goes to that beneficiary. Otherwise
it is delisted and the bond returns. A defended challenge does not
restart the cooldown. A beneficiary change before inclusion reverts.

Expire a question only after askedAt + PENDING_EXPIRY (strictly
older), or if Intake.requests(intakeId).completed is true. Any
challenge bond returns when an unanswered question is cleared.

Points are computed off chain from Stacked events and all listing
periods: 1 point per IMD when fromBlock <= block < toBlock. An open
period has no end. Credits outside periods are direct, no points.
Delisting preserves earlier points. No airdrop is promised.
Cashback value is the event shares through convertToAssets, not the
wallet's present share balance. Earned on top = value minus received.
